Text Encoding Initiative

The XML Version of the TEI Guidelines

<remarks>

<remarks> contains any commentary or discussion about the usage of an element, attribute, class, or entity not otherwise documented within the containing element.
Attributes Global attributes only
Example 
<remarks>
<p>This element is probably redundant.</p></remarks>
Note

As defined in ODD, must contain paragraphs; should be special.para
Module Declared in file teitsd2; Auxiliary DTD for Tag Set documentation
Data Description Contains at least one paragraph, unless it is empty.
May contain bibl biblFull biblStruct cb cit gap index l label lb lg list listBibl milestone note p pb q quote sp stage
May occur within
Declaration 
<!ELEMENT remarks %om.RO; (%component.seq;)> 
<!ATTLIST remarks  
      %a.global;>
See further 27.1 The TagDoc Documentation Element; 27.1.1 The AttList Documentation Element; 27.2 Element Classes; 27.3 Entity Documentation
